Based on my search, here are the current number of MLA and MP seats in Telangana:

## MLA Seats (Legislative Assembly)
**119 seats** - The Telangana Legislative Assembly currently has 119 elected members.

## MP Seats (Parliament)

### Lok Sabha (Lower House)
**17 seats** - Telangana has 17 Lok Sabha constituencies.

### Rajya Sabha (Upper House)
**7 seats** - Telangana has 7 Rajya Sabha seats.

## Important Note About Future Increase
The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 provides for increasing Telangana's Assembly seats from **119 to 153**. However, this increase is currently on hold because Article 170(3) of the Indian Constitution freezes any delimitation or seat readjustment until after the first census conducted after 2026. The Supreme Court of India dismissed a plea in July 2025 seeking early implementation of this increase, citing constitutional constraints.
